column45: [Hannah] Large discrepancy in mass measured between Cloutier+ (2021): 4.91 M_earth and Hirano+ (2021): 10.1 M_earth. The mass found by Luque & Pallé (2022) takes the RVs from the previous two papers and re-fits them, and ends up with an average between the two of 7.57 M_earth. If one of the sets of RVs has some systematic bias (which kind of looks like one of them does?) then I don't think we can trust this average.
